parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of custom domain names returned.

parameters.name: Prefix
parameters.description: The prefix of the custom domain name that you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae list-web-custom-domains --namespace-id cn-hangzhou --application-id 7e41aff0-9eca-45c9-ac48-675e09000000 --prefix remoteresult --next-token A2RN --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sae GET /pop/v2/api/web/custom-domains --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken A2RN --NamespaceId 'cn-hangzhou' --Prefix remoteresult --Limit 10 --ApplicationId '7e41aff0-9eca-45c9-ac48-675e09000000' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
